[message_id=687547 author=Caspian Lin first=True]
Can we use DoRA (Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation) to improve LoRA performance? I tried setting use_dora=True in the LoRA config, but I encountered an unknown error after submitting. Is DoRA supported in the final test submission? Or is this competition limited to using basic LoRA configurations?

[message_id=3435050 author=NNMax first=False]
Unfortunately I dont think DoRA is supported by vllm yet. You can see more details in this github issue .

[message_id=3435625 author=CPMP first=False]
You use whatever you want provided you submit a LORA adapter for the competition model. The way you produce the LORA adapter is totally open.

[message_id=3434993 author=Ryan Holbrook first=False]
Hi @caspianlin You could try it out using the provided evaluation metric here . Let us know your results!
